notes: Both styles ship year-only: the page states year digits only, with no month or week field. Patterns are disjoint by digit count (6 digits + letter vs 8 digits + letter), so no shape collision.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year (1-based), converted to [0,2]. Page example shown as '98-3140-A'; normalized form used here.
Page positions 1-4 = year (1-based), converted to [0,4]; a four-digit year is used as-is. Page example shown as '2000-3737-B'; normalized form used here.
